suggested_improvements: [LAYOUT] Problem: Long label '3,000,000,000 bp' renders over the right edge of cell_circle and nearly touches the screen's right border (off-screen risk).; Solution: Line 194: self.place_in_area(bp_text, 'B6', 'D6', scale_factor=0.55) to center the long text in the empty bottom band below the cell circle, keeping it fully on-screen; counter stays at E6 (line 197) so no overlap occurs.

[LAYOUT] Problem: books group occupies B2-D5, the same region as copier (D5), so the book grid and copier compete for the same cells and crowd the panel.; Solution: Line 244: self.place_in_area(books, 'B2', 'C4', scale_factor=0.9) to confine the book grid to the upper-left of the right panel, leaving column D free for the copier at D5.

[LAYOUT] Problem: copy_label 'Copy All Books' sits ~2 grid rows above the copier, violating the 1-unit proximity rule and floating in empty top-right space.; Solution: Line 253: self.place_at_grid(copy_label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.8) to place the label directly above the copier (D5), within 1 grid unit and clear of the resized books area B2-C4.
